{"consolidated_memory":"## Flapping Flag Issues in platform/featureflags/eval.go

The flag evaluator in platform/featureflags/eval.go has experienced two distinct flapping flag incidents, both characterized by a decision that alternates between calls when evaluating the same flag for one user repeatedly.

**OCCASION 1: January 2026 (Retry Loop Issue)**
- Date: 2026-01-09
- Trigger: Problem appeared only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root Cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff in the flag evaluator
- Fix: Capped the retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #2701 on branch fix/flapping-flag-1
- Covering Test: platform/featureflags/eval_test.go
- Stack: Go
- Outcome: The nightly rollup matched the source counts for 48 days running

**OCCASION 2: July 2026 (Transaction Issue)**
- Date: 2026-07-28
- Trigger: Problem appeared only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root Cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR: #8053 on branch fix/flapping-flag-3
- Covering Test: platform/featureflags/eval_test.go
- Stack: Go
- Outcome: The alert stayed quiet for 11 consecutive days

Both incidents required the same reproduction method and affected the same component, but had entirely different underlying causes requiring separate fixes."}
